title: Extreme Weather Can Backfire on China's Carbon Mitigation Efforts
displayTitle: Extreme Weather Can Backfire on China's Carbon Mitigation Efforts
authors: Jingbo Cui, Zhenxuan Wang,Jinglin Zhang, Junjie Zhang
venue: We find extreme heat substantially increases Chinses firms'emission. Findings identify a climate-emissions feedback and reveal a tension between adaptation and mitigation.

title: Mapping larch plantation and deforestation history in Qinling Region, China
displayTitle: Mapping larch plantation and deforestation history in Qinling Region, China
venue: This study used Jilin-1, PlanetScope and Landsat-5 images for multi-temporal supervised interpretation to reveal the current landscape patterns of larch plantation and historical deforestation activities in this region. A follow-up research wish to reveal the effects of historical landscape and long-term landscape dynamics on present-day understory biodiversity in plantation.
